services.desc: The McMichael is temporarily closed to begin a once-in-a-generation transformation. For thousands of years, the Toronto Carrying Place Trail connected the Great Lakes with Georgian Bay and beyond-a network of waterways and portage routes that shaped movement, trade, culture and settlement across the land we now call home. From Water to Water: A Land Acknowledgment traces that history through new drawings, watercolours, photographs, collaborative works and a new mural by Anishinaabe artist and scholar Bonnie Devine and Canadian photographer Robert Burley.
